rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when terror, amazement, or awe leaves someone motionless.

example.english: That terrifying scene can transfix me, leaving me unable to move.
example.traditional: 嗰個恐怖場面搞到我呆住，郁都郁唔到。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 hung2 bou3 coeng4 min2 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 ngoi4 zyu6 juk1 dou1 juk1 m4 dou3

rows.note: Use this specifically when a sharp weapon pierces through someone or something.

example.english: The spear can transfix the shield.
example.jyutping: baa2 coeng4 maau4 ci3 cyun1 zo2 go3 teon5 paai4
